method: Flesch Kincaid grade plus 5 estimates. Punctuated sentences and standalone task lines are sentence units. Fixed syllable overrides and vowel-group heuristic inherited from the reference method. Text and SHA-256 are retained per corpus. Estimates are not a learner assessment. Staff text, titles, codes and dates excluded. Fragmentary log prompts have limited numerical validity. Key vocabulary is taught aloud. No executable is supplied.
